prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: rear-end collision in Pearland, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported concussion. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1365; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Officers responded to a rear-end collision in Pearland, Texas. Driver 2 was stopped in the travel lane when the front of Driver 1's vehicle struck the rear of Driver 2's vehicle. Driver 2 stated that the impact pushed the vehicle forward and that Driver 2 struck the steering wheel. Driver 1 and Driver 2 both confirmed the sequence of events, and Driver 2 reported a concussion with headache and dizziness. A Passenger in Driver 1's vehicle was present at the scene and was able to describe the impact. Two independent witnesses stated that the collision occurred as described by both drivers. Officers photographed the scene and both vehicles. The rear damage to Driver 2's vehicle and the front damage to Driver 1's vehicle are consistent with the reported force of the impact. Officers observed no prior damage to either vehicle. Driver 1 produced an insurance card showing coverage in Driver 1's own name. Driver 2 was transported to a local hospital for evaluation. No citations were issued at the scene.
